title_zh: 智行京张公共地标目录
title_en: Jing-Zhang Autonomous Commons Public Landmark Catalogue
boundary: These are interpretive public-space proposals, not approved structures, sponsorships or construction commitments.

landmarks.public_purpose: 展示被暂停、被拒绝和回到人工服务的自动化决定，让退出权成为可见的公共记忆。
landmarks.public_purpose_en: Make paused, rejected and human-return decisions visible as public memory of the right to exit.
landmarks.maintenance_trigger: 季度可读性、无障碍和内容边界复核；缺失或误导时撤下内容。

landmarks.public_purpose: 以不含个人身份的聚合状态显示试验闸门、责任人和恢复条件。
landmarks.public_purpose_en: Show aggregate gate status, accountable roles and recovery conditions without personal identity.
landmarks.maintenance_trigger: 状态板过期、责任人缺失或恢复条件不可读时立即转为人工服务并更新公告。

landmarks.public_purpose: 把轨道到达、步行、轮椅、物流和人工服务放在同一张可解释的换乘叙事中。
landmarks.public_purpose_en: Explain rail arrival, walking, wheelchair, freight and staffed service as one legible transfer story.
landmarks.maintenance_trigger: 站口、消防、无障碍或活动日动线变化时暂停展示并重新做专业复核。
